description: This file defines the CallPopup class for managing call pop-up UI, including call status, contact info, and real-time call events in a telephony system.

classes.name: CallPopup
classes.description: Class managing the call popup UI, including call status, contact info, and real-time call event handling.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes CallPopup with call log data, sets up listeners, and creates the UI.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Creates and displays the call popup dialog, plays incoming call sound.

methods.name: setup_dialog
methods.description: Prepares the dialog content with call details.

methods.name: set_indicator
methods.description: Sets the visual indicator color and blink status based on call state.

methods.name: set_call_status
methods.description: Updates the call status and UI indicators based on call state.

methods.name: update_call_log
methods.description: Updates the call log data and call status.

methods.name: close_modal
methods.description: Hides the dialog and cleans up.

methods.name: call_ended
methods.description: Handles call end event, plays disconnect sound, updates log, and closes dialog after timeout.

methods.name: get_caller_name
methods.description: Retrieves caller's name or link title.

methods.name: get_contact_link
methods.description: Finds contact link associated with the call log.

methods.name: setup_listener
methods.description: Sets up real-time event listeners for call end and missed events.

methods.name: setup_call_details
methods.description: Initializes call detail UI components and buttons.

methods.name: is_known_caller
methods.description: Checks if caller's name is known.

methods.name: create_new_customer
methods.description: Creates a new customer record with caller number.

methods.name: create_new_contact
methods.description: Creates a new contact record with caller number.
